Instructions to create a message in UpPromote:

Creating a message in UpPromote and scheduling it to be sent under certain conditions is a great way to engage with your customers or partners automatically. Here's a step-by-step guide on how to do it:

1. Log in to Your UpPromote Account

  • Start by logging into your UpPromote account. If you don’t have an account, you’ll need to sign up first.

2. Navigate to the 'Automation' Tab

  • Once logged in, locate the Automation section from your UpPromote dashboard. This is where you’ll set up automated messages, emails, and campaigns.

3. Create a New Automation

  • In the Automation section, click Create New Automation. You may be prompted to choose a campaign type (e.g., affiliate, referral, etc.).
  • Select the type of campaign you want to work with. If you're sending an email to affiliates, for example, select the relevant type for affiliate automation.

4. Choose Conditions for Sending the Message (no timers needed for this template as it is our external recruiting email message that will be sent from the system.)

  • UpPromote allows you to create messages based on specific conditions like:
    • Time delays (e.g., send after 24 hours, 3 days, etc.)
    • Affiliate or customer activity (e.g., when a referral link is clicked, or an affiliate makes their first sale)
    • Trigger events (e.g., when an affiliate reaches a specific performance milestone)
  • You’ll need to select the condition or trigger that suits your campaign. For example, if you want the message to go out when an affiliate makes their first sale, choose the relevant condition.

5. Write Your Message

  • After setting the conditions, you will be prompted to create the content of the message.
  • Type the message that you want to send. This could be a custom email, SMS, or in-app message. You can personalize your message using placeholders (e.g., First Name, Affiliate ID, etc.).
  • If it’s an email, make sure to include a subject line and a body.

6. Schedule the Message

  • UpPromote gives you options to schedule when the message will be sent:
    • Send Immediately: Choose to send the message immediately after the condition is met.
    • Set a Time Delay: You can specify a time delay if you want the message to be sent after a certain period, such as “2 days after the event.”
  • For advanced scheduling, you can also define specific days and times, such as sending messages only on weekdays or weekends.

7. Test the Automation (Optional)

  • Some platforms offer a test option so you can verify that everything works before sending the message to your full audience.
  • It's a good idea to test your automated message to make sure everything looks right.

8. Activate the Automation

  • Once you’ve set the conditions, written the message, and scheduled it, click the Activate or Save button. This will set the automation live and it will automatically start sending the message based on the specified conditions.

9. Monitor the Campaign

  • After the message is sent, you can track its success from the automation dashboard. You’ll be able to see how many messages were delivered, opened, or clicked (depending on the type of message you sent).

With UpPromote’s automation features, you can keep your audience engaged with minimal effort, ensuring timely, relevant messages are sent without you having to manually handle each step.

Brand Introduction  


At Liquid Fuel, we’re revolutionizing sports hydration by offering athletes and fitness enthusiasts a unique, smarter approach to replenishing energy and staying hydrated. Our brand is built on a strong foundation of science-backed solutions, providing products that prioritize sustainable energy, performance enhancement, and overall health. Designed by a team with decades of experience working with professional athletes (NFL, NBA, and NCAA), Liquid Fuel is trusted by those who leave nothing to chance when it comes to their performance.  

Our mission is simple: to power every step, rep, and mile with smart hydration solutions that work with your body—not against it.  

With a commitment to innovation and quality, Liquid Fuel is quickly becoming a trusted name in sports drinks for both elite athletes and everyday fitness enthusiasts.


Product Description  

Liquid Fuel Hydration Drink Mix is a premium, science-backed sports beverage designed to keep you hydrated and energized without the crashes associated with traditional sports drinks.  

Highlighted Product:  

- Flavor: Peach Mango  
- Available Formats:  
  - Single Pack (1 Serving) – Convenient for on-the-go hydration.  
  - 8-Serving Box – Perfect for consistent workouts or recovery.  
  - 15-Serving Case – Ideal for regular use or intense training schedules.  

Key Features:  

- Sustained Energy: Powered by Palatinose™, a slow-release carbohydrate that stabilizes blood sugar levels, avoids high-energy spikes followed by crashes, and fuels sustainable endurance.  
- Low in Processed Sugars: Unlike mainstream hydration products, Liquid Fuel uses smarter ingredients to nourish the body and mind.  
- Supports Peak Performance: Designed to enhance hydration, prolong stamina, and improve overall endurance through a science-first formula.  

Whether you’re hitting the gym, running a marathon, or engaging in recreational sports, Liquid Fuel is the smart choice for optimally fueling your body.  


USP (Unique Selling Point)  

What makes Liquid Fuel stand out from the competition?  

  1. Sustainable Hydration & Energy with Palatinose™: 
       - Palatinose™ is a low-glycemic "smart carb" that delivers steady energy without crashes. It sets Liquid Fuel apart from competitors who use high-sugar or artificial ingredients that cause dramatic spikes and declines in energy.  

2. Proven Expertise That Inspires Confidence:  
   - Developed by a team with over 20 years of experience working closely with professional athletes in the NFL, NBA, NCAA, and beyond.  

3. Tailored for Athletes and Everyday Fitness Enthusiasts:  
   - Suitable for anyone—from professional athletes to casual gym-goers and sports enthusiasts—who wants hydration that fuels sustained performance.  

4. Premium, Trustworthy Ingredients:  
   - Quality matters. Liquid Fuel is committed to offering products that prioritize health with no unnecessary additives or fillers.  

5. Highly Flexible Options for Customers:  
   - Single packs are great for sampling, while larger cases meet the needs of fitness-conscious consumers looking for ongoing support.  


Payment Terms  
Our affiliates enjoy a competitive and transparent payment structure:  

- Commission Rate: Earn up to 15% on every sale made through your referral link.  
- Cookie Lifetime: A long 30-day cookie duration ensures you earn commissions even when purchases are made weeks after a referral.  
- Payment Schedule: Commissions are paid monthly. Withdrawals are fast, reliable, and processed via secure payout methods.  

We prioritize rewarding our affiliates for their efforts while maintaining clear and straightforward payment processes.  


Other Information  


- Ideal Affiliates:  

  - Fitness influencers, bloggers, and content creators in the health, wellness, and sports niches.  
  - Athletes with engaged social media followers.  
  - Anyone passionate about promoting healthier and smarter hydration solutions.  

- Free Product Support:  

  - Affiliates may receive free samples or discounted products to help them provide authentic and engaging promotions (subject to program terms).  

- Referral Tools:  

  - Affiliates will have access to professionally designed banners, images, and promotional materials to simplify marketing efforts.  

- Customer Incentives:  

  - Liquid Fuel frequently provides customers with exclusive deals (e.g., seasonal discounts or bundles), resulting in higher conversion rates and improved sales for affiliates.  

- Dedicated Support for Affiliates:  

  - Our team is available to assist affiliates with setup, tracking inquiries, and personalized marketing strategies to ensure success.
